item.title: What is a Skill?
item.description:
LangChain · score 6 · hits agent, agents, skill, langchain

Learn what agent skills are and how they help long-running agents manage their own context window. A skill is a folder of instructions, scripts, and reference docs for a specific task. Your agent loads only each skill's name and description at startup, then opens the full skill when a task calls for it; this keeps context small, so you spend fewer tokens and make your agent faster. Learn more: → LangChain Academy Deep Agents course: https://academy.langchain.com/courses/foundation-introduction-t

item.title: Agentic Apps: How Big Companies Are Actually Deploying AI Agents
item.description:
Cole Medin · score 6 · hits agent, agents, agentic, workflow

Pretty much every AI agent I've built for myself is one agent I chat with. That's great for my own work, but it's not how companies actually adopt AI a lot of the time. So in this video I go through the lessons I end up teaching every company I work with, and how that takes shape as what Oracle calls agentic apps! Multiple agents working toward one goal, AI only where you need judgment, rules turned into actual code with tests, and a person approving anything that matters. ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
